name: List the runners
description: Admin only. THE FLEET, not one admin's machines: a runner that is wedged is everyone's problem, so this route is scoped to the deployment rather than to the caller, unlike GET /v1/runner-keys. It answers the two operational questions nothing else can -- which machine is playing, and which machine is holding rows it is not finishing -- which is what matches.played_by exists for. `live` recomputes live_runners' predicate as a field rather than filtering by it, because a revoked runner is exactly the row an operator is looking for.
